instruction_and_question_checks: All original question strings and common instruction preserved byte-for-byte; all critical-criteria structures preserved. Original rubric bytes copied exactly. Operational historical stage/sampling-status metadata is explicitly updated.

source_fairness.nli: Neutral descriptions of HANS, PAWS and SuperGLUE WSC tasks, released label formats and established scoring; no adverse-response quote, item gold, fixed preferred resource, or invented WSC three-way label. WSC wording specifies labeled public records.
source_fairness.math: Neutral original GSM8K format, GSM-Symbolic released templates/generated instances versus unpublished full generator, and primary SVAMP variation taxonomy. No source assertion that finite behavior establishes or disproves an internal reasoning mechanism. No unverified numeric CSV variation-code mapping enters a card.
source_fairness.alternatives: Both source cards explicitly leave benchmark choice and validated alternatives/adaptations open.

length_confound: Contexts are roughly word-length matched (217/229 source words versus236 generic), with close character counts. Tokenization, authority, specificity and semantics are not matched. Interpret as supplied evidence/instruction package, not pure browsing or source-facts-only effect.
instruction_scope: Original common instruction says existing knowledge and prohibits browsing/tools; the treatment is additional user-provided context in the same request. No browsing occurred. The instruction text was kept identical rather than silently rewritten.
review_packet_policy: Original question plus ordinary final response and unchanged case definitions. Hide complete treatment input, arm, model, repetition, order, usage and source-card version. Natural response wording may still reveal source availability.
utility_scope: Prospective secondary usefulness outcome has four labels and does not tighten primary requirements. A valid method with a usable bounded conclusion can retain useful content even if another explicit claim creates a primary error; record governing scope carefully. Genuine necessary clarification is accepted when informative, not mere vague caution.
mechanism_scope: Three exact target flags are separate from any primary error, the old PAWS directionality flag and other_material. A different error is never replication of a target.
freeze_requirements: Independent source/fidelity review and final root approval of methodological choices before sampling
Git freeze of exact manifest/protocol/cards/cases/rubric/runner and relevant sources
Pin review_casepack bytes in external freeze (currently not included in protocol.hashes)
All72requests once; no retries or outcome-based additions; no model-performance or ranking claim from advice alone
